content:
Returns a list of exposure view cards based on your search criteria.
Caution: This endpoint is available for use but is currently in beta. The response structure is subject
to change as we continue to enhance the data model.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the TONE_UI.TONE_EXPOSURE_CARD.READ ,
LUMIN_EXPOSURE_VIEW.EXPOSURE_CARD.READ , and AD.TOGGLE_AD.USE  custom role privileges.
See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
QUERY PARAMETERS
boolean
Indicates whether or not to return Tenable-provided global cards or user-
created custom cards.
If true , only Tenable-provided global cards are returned. If false , only
user-created custom cards are returned. If this parameter is omitted,
Tenable One returns all cards.
is_global_card
string
Filters the results by card name.
string
Default: "asc"
Enum: "asc"
"desc"
The order to sort the results by, either ascending ( asc ) or descending
( desc ).
integer
[ 1 .. 25 ]
Default: 25
The number of card records to retrieve. The maximum value is 25 . If this
parameter is omitted, Tenable One uses the default value of 25 .
integer
>= 0
Default: 0
The starting record to retrieve. If this parameter is omitted, Tenable One
uses the default value of 0 .
